work: Bay Glory is a separately ticketed 128-metre observation wheel with 28 cabins within the mixed-use OH Bay waterfront of Shenzhen. The coastal park and shops are not a structured amusement park. Park and Standalone English, Chinese, and Shenzhen searches in the official editor found no same-site entry. Created hidden with eight authored descriptions, sourced 2021 opening and October 2019 assembly milestones, Ctrip weekly wheel-specific hours, and three exact CC BY-SA 4.0 Commons photographs. Corrected a public-text audit blocker, then published the site and Facebook post.
qualification: Fixed wheel with its own ticket reservation inside an urban waterfront complex; no parent amusement park with parkItems.
